hypothesis: A cross-horizon shape layer trained only on earlier matured residual-layer forecasts changes matched endpoint error relative to the residual-layer forecast alone.
material_difference: The existing curve-shape transform consumes authenticated learned_residual forecasts rather than direct forecasts. It changes no base model, target, horizon grid, source population, base-model configuration or residual-layer parameters.

inputs.universe: all68 pinned by the authenticated currency-projection parent
inputs.availability: maximum constituent residual forecast available_epoch; an incomplete curve is an explicit non-issuance

chronology.training: only origins strictly before the current origin, with every constituent forecast available by the snapshot cutoff and its exact endpoint outcome mature by that cutoff
chronology.application: snapshot cutoff no later than current origin; current outcome is never an input
chronology.negative_control: future outcome, future residual prediction, in-sample source forecast, and target/anchor mismatch must refuse

acceptance: A completed package requires authenticated residual and projection lineage, source/test failure cases, a real retained-data result, same-task review, compact Vault handoff, and separately recorded independent-review status. It makes no confirmation, policy, native issuance, trading, broker or live-bot claim.
